title: Trainee Drafter
content_text:
ACOR Consultants Trainee Drafter (job AC987). Sydney NSW. Full time.

Our Civil Engineering team is currently seeking a Trainee Drafter. The position is suited to an entry level candidate with desire to learn about civil engineering and digital design.

The opportunity:
- Technical design and documentation of civil projects including earthworks, drainage, grading and pavements
- Coordination with clients, engineers, designers, and authorities on civil design projects
- Actively contribute as part of a team working on building infrastructure and urban development projects nationally.
- Produce detailed drawings using software such as 12D and AutoCAD
- Work collaboratively with other design disciplines to ensure the integration of the overall design or solution.

Required skills and Experience:
- Currently studying or recently completed Cert IV or Diploma in a relevant field (Civil Construction Design or similar)
- A willingness to learn and develop skills with an interest in digital design
- A high level of attention to detail
- Excellent teamwork and communication skills
- Australian citizen eligible for baseline security clearance

Published on LiveHire 29 Jun 2026.
